[P2] Document the breaking operation-hook scheduling change

The base implementation and CHANGELOG identify another breaking change: the five operation hooks are no longer awaited, and their asynchronous work can finish out of order. A custom plugin that initializes span state after an await in `onOperationStart` can therefore reach its wrapper before that state exists, even after following this guide's factory migration. Add migration guidance covering synchronous state initialization, explicit queuing for ordered asynchronous work, and the bounded drain before `onInvocationEnd`; clarify that `onInvocationStart` and wrappers remain inline.
